title: alisma plantago-aquatica subsp. arcuatum
intro: Alisma plantago-aquatica subsp. arcuatum, commonly known as the Asian water plantain, is a perennial aquatic plant that belongs to the family Alismataceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of edema, inflammation, and fever, due to its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to promote urination, reduce swelling, and alleviate pain, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Alisma plantago-aquatica subsp. arcuatum include iridoid glycosides, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
